product_metadata.title: Costablue Insulated Water Bottle - On-The-Go Refillable Stainless Steel Water Bottles For Adults, Reusable Thermos Travel Tumbler With Leak-proof Lid For Hot & Cold Beverages (17Oz. Ligth Charcoal)
features: STAINLESS STEEL DURABLE WATER BOTTLE: Costablue’s water bottles are made with BPA-free 18/8 stainless steel for added strength and durability. Our double-wall insulated water bottle includes a convenient push-lock open lid easy to open and sip. It features simple colors and modern patterns, textures while delivering superb functionality

STAY HYDRATED ON THE GO: This thermos water bottle holds a capacity of 17 oz in volume which allows you to enjoy, beverage at the perfect temperature anytime and anywhere. Our smart water bottle will surely be your wonderful companion in your busy lifestyle. Select your ideal color of a bottle from ourrange of several colorsor designs patterns like Beverly Hills and Santa Monica

LONG LASTING TEMPERATURE CONTROL: Costablue’s water containers are insulated with a double-wall layer to prevent condensation for providing an exterior that will not sweat in your hands or bags. Its double-walled construction helps keep beverages hot for 5 hours and cold for 12 hours. Perfect to use while traveling, gym, hitting road trips, anywhere you want

SAY NO TO SPILLS AND LEAKS: This travel water bottle has a secured, leak-proof push-lock opening that removes the risk of spills whenever you aren’t using the water bottle. Care is important on keeping your lid or bottle is in place in a standing condition. The lid should be properly tightened and closed to avoid spills and splashes

WASHING INSTRUCTIONS: Our insulated water bottles are easy to wash with no prior knowledge needed for washing them, just the lid of the bottle can be placed in the top rack dishwasher to refresh it and the bottle is suggested to be hand-washed only.
